proves.claim: show prints one 'after-gate: N min saved, M rebuilds' line right after the after-gate line, summed from the after-gate notes on the listed parents.

cli.commands-show.after-gate-measure-lin.why: A reader of show must see what the after-gate flow saved and how often it rebuilt.

proves.claim: show prints no 'min saved' line for a plain --after or for an after-gate list whose parent has no after-gate notes.

cli.commands-show.no-after-gate-measure-.why: The line appears only when a listed parent carries a measurement.
